intent: Preserve Viewer SDP through Android offer extraction to remove the identified native negotiation blocker; first-frame restoration remains physical-required.

requestReview.reason: Preserve SDP payload bytes at the existing offer read boundary. No requests, subscriptions, timers or retry policies are added; successful negotiation may resume the already-budgeted session traffic. TURN provisioning remains unresolved.
requestReview.assumptions: No request lifecycle changes are included.
